effect.shortEffect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
effect.full: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

french.sv: Le sel pur immunise le Pokémon contre les altérations\nde statut, et diminue de moitié les dégâts des capacités\nde type Spectre.

english.sv: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

japanese.sv: 清らかな塩で　状態異常に　ならない。 ゴーストタイプの　技の ダメージを　半減させる。
